export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never UV_NO_PROGRESS=1; for f in 'good' 'bad'; do ( cd "$f" && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="/daodan/state/venvs/$f" uv sync --locked --all-packages --no-install-project ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 || if [ -s /daodan/state/without-vcs.txt ]; then mv /tmp/daodan-restore.log /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; ( cd "$f" && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="/daodan/state/venvs/$f" uv sync --locked --all-packages --no-install-project $(sed 's/ .*//; s/^/--no-install-package /' /daodan/state/without-vcs.txt) ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 && { printf 'DAODAN-VCS-FAILED uv %s
' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|needs to be updated|No solution|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-VCS-END; } >&2 || { cat /tmp/daodan-restore.log >> /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED uv %s
' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|needs to be updated|No solution|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; }; else { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED uv %s
' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|needs to be updated|No solution|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; fi; done; true
